finding.question: Did the New York Post's editorial board endorse Donald Trump for re-election in the 2020 U.S. presidential election?
finding.summary: The New York Post published an editorial on October 26, 2020, explicitly endorsing Donald Trump for re-election. Contemporaneous reporting by The Atlanta Journal-Constitution and Fox News corroborated the endorsement and attributed it to the paper’s editorial staff or board.
